title.narrative: Enhancing Community Development in Mukuru, Kenya. Youth leaders.

description.narrative: The youth leader exchange will support the implementation of a CISU-funded project implemented by Kenya Red Cross (KRCS) and Danish Red Cross Youth focusing on capacitating youth in Mukuru to take lead on community development. The project is implemented in Kenya?s second largest informal settlement, Mukuru with approximately 700.000 residents of which the vast majority are young people. Mukuru is a highly underdeveloped area with widespread poverty, crime and very limited livelihood opportunities. The youth leader exchange will support the project by strengthening the capacity of core KRCS youth volunteers to support local youth in Mukuru in building personal capacities and initiate youth-led projects to enhance living conditions in the settlements. Moreover the youth leader exchange will support the project by strengthening the local youth networks and capacitate youth in Mukuru to raise their voice on youth issues.
